name: mobilebox-examples
description: Checks for the Mobilebox examples. The core examples have no dependencies; examples/integrations use each framework's own package.

scripts.lint: tsc -p . && node --check examples/github-actions/smoke.mjs && node --check scripts/check-mcp.mjs && python3 -m py_compile examples/python/mobilebox.py examples/integrations/*/agent.py && node --check examples/integrations/mastra/agent.ts && node --check examples/integrations/vercel-ai-sdk/agent.ts && node --check examples/integrations/claude-agent-sdk/agent.ts && for f in benchmarks/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node benchmarks/summarize.mjs > /dev/null
